description: Presidential Secretariat - Cultivation of oil palm be totally prohibited
reasoning: This gazette content is a presidential proclamation that imposes a total ban on Oil Palm cultivation in Sri Lanka. It cites constitutional articles (27(2)(c), (e) and 27(14)) and invokes presidential powers under Article 33 of the Constitution. The content establishes new legal prohibitions and directives regarding agricultural practices, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. It creates binding legal requirements that must be followed, which falls squarely under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
